purpose: A source-grounded interpretation statement refactored into a retrieval and regression-test record.

evidence_boundary.source_derived: Text preserved or normalized from a supplied source.
evidence_boundary.computed: A deterministic calculation output with explicit settings and engine metadata.
evidence_boundary.methodology_bound: A score or rule defined by a named tradition or project methodology.
evidence_boundary.research_exploratory: A hypothesis or association requiring time-aware validation.
evidence_boundary.interpretive_text: Never treated as empirical, causal, medical, legal, psychological, or financial evidence.

deduplication.probable: semantic similarity or shared keywords; preserve separate pending-review records
deduplication.source_merge: merge source_ids and source_paths only for exact duplicates
